explanations.a: Mandrel is used inside hollow tubes to maintain or form internal shape during swaging.
explanations.b: Tool is used but not always essential.
explanations.c: Jig is not required in swaging.
explanations.d: Fixture is not required in swaging.

answers.a: reduce the length of the workpiece
answers.b: increase the outer diameter of the workpiece
answers.c: reduce the outer diameter of the workpiece

explanations.b: Outer diameter is not increased but compressed.

questions.question: The various parts which can be produced by swaging technique:

explanations.a: Billets are raw stock, not swaged products.
explanations.b: Pipes and connectors are commonly swaged.
explanations.d: Tyres are not manufactured by swaging.

questions.question: Which is not a swaging machine:

explanations.a: Tagging machine is a swaging type.

questions.question: Swaging technique involves removal of material:

explanations.a: Material is not removed in swaging.
explanations.b: Correct, swaging plastically deforms without chip formation.

questions.question: The stresses involved in making of swaged part are generally compressive in:

explanations.a: Swaging uses radial compressive loads to form the part.

questions.question: The swaging process is generally carried out with the help of the two dies/punches:

explanations.a: Swaging commonly uses split dies closing radially.
Rotary swaging is also known as radial forging due to radial die motion.
